# SEED NOTES — where every seeded row came from, and what was left out

status: GENERATED — pending curation by The Scientist

Seeded 2026-08-17 by `scripts/skadi_seed.py`. **Nothing here was measured by Skaði.** Every row is a prior imported from work already paid for, and every seeded atlas row cites this file in its `evidence` column so the provenance is one click from the claim.

## 1. THE BEHAVIOUR LEDGER, n=8

Thirteen rows imported from the markdown table in `.claude/skills/lofn-render-audit/SKILL.md` (*THE SUNO BEHAVIOUR LEDGER — n=8, first full deep dive, 2026-07-24*). `n` is kept exactly as the ledger recorded it. That skill's table remains its own working buffer; ATLAS.md is the canonical accumulator from here. **The pointer edit in the skill is Lofn's to make, not a builder's.**

**Confidence mapping — deliberately conservative.** The ledger uses a five-step scale (`low`, `low-medium`, `medium`, `medium-high`); the atlas has three (`LOW`/`MEDIUM`/`HIGH`). Mapping used: `low`→`LOW`, `low-medium`→`LOW`, `medium`→`MEDIUM`, `medium-high`→`MEDIUM`. Every hyphenated step maps DOWN, so **no seeded row is `HIGH`**. That is on purpose: a validator may lower a claim and never promote one, and only The Scientist promotes a claim to doctrine.

**Two `n` values were recorded as inequalities** — foley `≥4` and named exotic timbres `≥3`. The atlas `n` column is an integer because `check_confidence_vs_n` has to read it, so the conservative lower bound is stored (4 and 3). The ledger's `≥` is recorded here and nowhere lost.

**SK-012 verdict.** The ledger row reads *"stereo image — spans 0.812–0.945 correlation, NOT a universal mono renderer"*. That is a refutation of a prior claim, not an arrival of a requested thing, so it is banked as `PARTIAL` (genuine stereo movement exists; declared placement is not reliably honoured) rather than `ARRIVES`. Flagged for curation.

## 2. THE STANDING CONTROLS

- **Positive control** — `steady-tempo`, expected `ARRIVES` (from `SK-001`, the strongest row in the ledger at n=6).
- **Negative control** — `interrupting-silence`, expected `SMOOTHED` (from `SK-005`: both explicit voids vanished, 2 of 2).

A plate whose control does not return its expected verdict is **VOID**: no claim banks from it and every ledger row on it records `VOID-PLATE`. The controls are also the control chart's series — the same probes re-rendered, so the points are comparable and a model-epoch change shows up as a special cause rather than as claims quietly rotting.

## 3. THE 2026-08-13 INVERSION LAW — `SKOP-01`

Seeded as an **OPERATOR** claim, and deliberately into **CONJECTURED** rather than BANKED. The evidence from that run is a *specification-level* finding: six songs were rewritten so the modern genre is the world and the historical element is one named intrusion at one seam, and the pass was judged on the text. **No blind listening pass was ever run on those renders.** Its lane is `LISTENER`, and a LISTENER-lane claim with no blind artifact is exactly what `check_lanes` exists to refuse — so it sits in CONJECTURED until a plate hears it.

⛔ **The row is a PREDICTION, and its numbers say so: `n = 0`, `confidence` empty.** It was first seeded at `n=2, LOW`, carrying the six-song run's evidence as though that run had observed the law through this system's instrument. It had not. Those six renders were judged **on the text of the specification**, which is why the row is on this shelf at all — so the same file cannot also be the count that makes it look measured. The run paths stay in `evidence` because they are exactly what a stranger should re-open to see why we expect `TRANSFORMS`: they are **motivating, not confirming**. The predicted verdict is unchanged and stays TRANSFORMS-scoped as the panel stated it. A verdict column on this shelf holds what we expect to find, and being wrong there is the point of registering it.

**It is nonetheless #1 in the replication queue** (menu slot P3), because it is already steering runs. That is the ERC post-mortem's lesson transplanted: a check scheduled behind the effort it was meant to condition is not a check. Until a HEARD pass lands, `n` stays 0 — the count is of hearings, and there have been none.

## 4. THE CATALOGUE FOOTPRINT

`footprint` in TERRITORIES.md counts prior work: songs under `output/songs/` whose frontmatter genre/style text matches a base genre of the territory, and public Suno clips in `data/snapshots/suno/latest.json` whose `tags` text does. 39 of 57 territories show any footprint at all.

Matching is word-boundary and requires a name of at least 4 characters, so short bases (`Dub`, `Bop`, `Ska`, `Emo`) cannot vacuum up half the catalogue. It is coarse on purpose. **A footprint is not a probe:** every territory is `UNEXPLORED` because Skaði has run nothing.

## 5. THE EXISTING RENDER AUDITS

`output/render-audits/2026-07-24-eight-song-deep-dive/` supplies the numeric evidence (`measurements.json`) and the blind listening artifacts (`<song>/blind_listener.json`, `<song>/intent_comparison.json`) that the LISTENER-lane seed rows cite. Three other audit directories exist (`2026-08-02-hear-learn`, `2026-08-10-spare-hair-tie`, `2026-08-10-wide-corpus`); they are calibration and corpus work rather than per-song intent comparisons, so they are **not** attached to claims here. Flagged for curation.

## 6. ⛔ DELIBERATELY NOT SEEDED — the audience findings

The token findings are **audience** findings, not grain claims, and seeding them here would put the wrong instrument on the wrong axis:

- *sung-line density is the strongest correlate of like-rate* (r = +0.538, n = 72 with the Triple Arch outlier removed; then lyric_chars +0.402, duration +0.321, words_per_line −0.202)
- *`phonk` 0.0217 and `baile` 0.0224 against a 0.0355 baseline*

**The lane boundary.** Skaði measures what the GENERATOR does with an ask — a claim here is refuted by a render. Those findings measure what an AUDIENCE does with a finished song — they are refuted by a different catalogue, and they live in `apps/lofn-analytics` and `vault/BENCHMARKS.md`. Mixing them would let a popularity statistic wear a grain claim's evidence ladder.

**And the class has already burned us once.** The standing finding *"snarl and phonk are our two worst-performing style tokens"* was retracted: it divided by a play-weighted baseline that was 93% one viral clip. Against a per-clip median, `snarl` sat AT baseline. That is the third instance of *a statistic dominated by one surface, generalised into a rule about the artist* — see `vault/RUN_LEDGER.md` and `data/snapshots/suno/ANALYSIS_2026-08-07_the_snarl_retraction.md`. An atlas that imported it would have been steering runs off a retraction.

## 7. THE SCRUFF SHELF SEED — beyond §6 of the design

The six PRODUCTIVE DEVIATIONS from `.claude/skills/lofn-render-audit/SKILL.md` are seeded onto the scruff shelf at status `PROMOTED`. The design's seeding list does not enumerate them; they are seeded anyway because harvest capture is mandatory (constitution §6) and a shelf that starts empty teaches the first expedition that the shelf is optional. **They carry song slugs, not probe ids** — they predate the probe protocol — so they can never reach the rift threshold on their own. Flagged for curation.

## 8. TERRITORY CLUSTERING — how it was done and where it will be wrong

`vault/genres.txt` holds 1200 `<Modifier> <Genre>` compounds. 32 leading tokens occur 20+ times and are treated as MODIFIERS; stripping them yields 426 base genres, hand-clustered into **57 territories** by an ordered rule list plus an explicit override table, both in `scripts/skadi_seed.py`. The mapping is deterministic and total: a base that no rule reaches makes the seed **refuse**, because a silent `(unsorted)` bucket is how a map starts lying.

Known imperfections, all flagged for curation:

- **Stripping loses real compounds.** `Garage Rock` becomes `Rock`, `Dream Pop` survives only because a rule names it. The compounds are not lost — they are the OPERATOR program's probe material.
- **One guard was necessary.** `Psychedelic Glitch Hop` strips twice to the non-genre `Hop`; a `NEVER_A_BASE` set stops the loop one token early so it lands on `Glitch Hop`.
- **`Mentor`** (5 entries) is almost certainly a corruption of **Mento**, the Jamaican form. Mapped to Afro-Caribbean & Tropical on that reading. If the file meant something else, this is wrong.
- **`Columbia`** is read as the Cuban rumba style (it sits beside `Yambu` and `Guaguanco` in the same file), not the country.
- **Cross-family compounds go to the noun, not the adjective**: `Jazz Metal` and `Folk Metal` land in Metal, `Gospel Blues` in Blues, `Ska Punk` in Ska. Defensible, arguable, and cheap to change.

## 9. SPEC CLASSES

25 classes, seeded from the behaviour ledger's own spec classes, `scripts/measure_render.py`'s measurement capabilities, and the 55 categories of `vault/music_frames.csv`. The design asked for ~20–24; this is 25 because the panel's OPERATOR program needs two classes of its own (`blend-of-two`, `modifier-application`) that no cell class covers. The frames categories are **mixed-axis** — `Drums` is an instrument, `Glitch` a genre, `Field Recording` a practice — so they are listed as probe-design raw material and are explicitly NOT territories and NOT spec classes.
